$comment: Name fixes, keyed by normalized name (lowercase letters and digits only). duplicatePicks: names TEdit gives to several items, mapped to the item a loadout almost certainly means (by TEdit key). ambiguous: shared names with no sensible default; they need an item ID. redirects: names whose only exact match is a placeholder players never hold (TEdit's ShellphoneDummy), mapped to the real item; the placeholder is also left out of the item dropdown. renamed: old names for saves up to and including 'until'. npm run sync-data appends to renamed automatically when an item's name changes.
